a) video summarization is a key problem in video mining and search; b) we can solve the video summarization by selecting key objects; c) we can solve key object selection as a sparse dictionary problem; d) our new formulation of sparse dictionary problem can better locate key video objects.
We present a new video summary approach that selects key objects from video frames.

we propose to summarize a long video into a few representative key objects by selecting object proposals generated from the video frames, and we formulate the representative selection problem as a sparse dictionary learning problem that can incorporate object proposal prior and locality prior in a unified framework.
